## llm-contract 0.9.1

This patch aligns the package's public metadata and documentation after the initial release. There are no runtime API changes from 0.9.0.

### Highlights

- New interactive documentation site at [alivirgo.github.io/LLM-Contract](https://alivirgo.github.io/LLM-Contract/).
- GitHub repository display name and canonical links aligned to `alivirgo/LLM-Contract`.
- npm homepage, repository, bugs, description, README, and `llms.txt` metadata aligned with the public site.
- Search, light/dark themes, responsive navigation, copyable examples, FAQ structured data, sitemap, robots rules, and a machine-readable package guide.
- GitHub Pages deployment pinned to current official GitHub Actions releases with least-privilege permissions.

### Install

```bash
npm install llm-contract
```

### Verification

- TypeScript typecheck and package build pass.
- 53 tests pass across 18 test files.
- CI verifies Node.js 18, 20, 22, and 24.
- The documentation HTML, JavaScript, local assets, canonical metadata, and structured data were checked before deployment.
